verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Workflows product lets users define trigger-based automation rules (event/property-based triggers → automated actions like emails, CRM updates, task creation), and this is compounded by AI agents (prospecting agent, deal progression) that act automatically on signals/events. Webhooks API also supports event-driven third-party automation. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of complex conditional logic depth or reliability at scale, and detail on trigger types is thin (just 'create workflows').
